summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py adds EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum) with the eleven members and their values, each commented with meaning and type. (2) botocore/args.py imports the enum as EPRBuiltins; _should_set_global_sts_endpoint now accepts an absent endpoint config (None treated as no variant tags); new public method compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults added after _ensure_boolean, returning a dict keyed by the enum members. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py adds TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with 16 tests covering every behavioral criterion, using subTest loops for true/false pairs and exactly one test each for the custom-data legacy and bundled-data SDK endpoint cases. Verification: tests/unit/test_args.py passes (53 tests, 16 new), related suites test_regions/test_client/test_endpoint pass, and the full unit suite shows the same 11 pre-existing failures (test_awsrequest, test_session, test_session_legacy) with and without the changes. Lines are within 79 columns; black and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so formatting was checked by hand. Choices to review: the helper calls the bridge's underscore-prefixed _resolve_endpoint_variant_config_var and _resolve_use_dualstack_endpoint because no public equivalents exist; a None S3 config is treated as an empty mapping. Nothing is committed.
